candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order /v1/orders returns HTTP 500, indicating an order-service server-side failure.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs/metrics absent; the specific order failure mode (db pool, redis, payment) is not determined.

report.explanation: Gateway logs show every /v1/checkout 502 paired with a client POST to order /v1/orders returning 500, and topology confirms gateway->order dependency. Root cause lies downstream in order, but order-side telemetry is missing, so only a generic http-500 candidate is supported.
missing_evidence: Order service logs and metrics for /v1/orders 500 responses
Database connection pool saturation metrics for order
Redis and payment dependency latency/error metrics from order
